verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that users can go to Accounts → Account Details to view account and routing numbers anytime and generate a bank verification letter from the same screen, which covers both parts of the story. The FAQ reference to printing check books with your Relay account and routing number supports that these numbers are accessible. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the verification-letter generation and in-depth documentation of the letter's contents.
